# Charmed Family Salon

> Charmed Family Salon is a premium unisex salon in Garia, Kolkata, India — offering hair, grooming, skin, nails, makeup and bridal services for men, women and kids. Rated 4.8★ on Google with 131+ reviews. 7+ years in service.

## Quick facts

- **Business name**: Charmed Family Salon (also: Charmed Unisex Salon)
- **Type**: Unisex hair, beauty and bridal salon
- **Address**: 259, Anandapally Lane, Mahamaya Tala, Garia, Kolkata – 700084, West Bengal, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 89819 65553
- **Hours**: Monday–Sunday, 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM (open every day)
- **Rating**: 4.8 / 5 on Google (131+ reviews)
- **Price range**: ₹₹ (mid-range, transparent pricing)
- **Founded**: 7+ years of service
- **Booking**: WhatsApp preferred (slot confirmed in under 5 minutes); walk-ins welcome

## What makes Charmed notable

- True unisex salon with dedicated services for men, women and kids under one roof
- Trained, certified stylists, barbers and beauticians
- Premium professional brands (VLCC, O3+, ammonia-free hair colour)
- Strict hygiene: fresh towels per client, sterilised tools, single-use razors
- 10% off first visit for new clients (mention when booking)
- Serves clients from across South Kolkata, not just Garia

## Areas served

Garia (primary location), and clients regularly travel from: Sonarpur, Narendrapur, Baghajatin, Patuli, Mukundapur, Santoshpur, Bansdroni, Regent Park, Jadavpur, Kamalgazi, and across South Kolkata.

## Services offered

**For men**: haircut & styling, beard trim & styling, clean razor shave, beard colour, men's hair colour, men's facial & cleanup, head massage, hair spa, groom's package.

**For women**: haircut, hair colour (ammonia-free), keratin treatment, smoothening, hair spa, highlights; facial, cleanup, detan, bleach, waxing, threading; manicure, pedicure, nail art, gel polish; party makeup, eye makeup, saree draping; bridal makeup (HD/airbrush), pre-bridal sessions, full bridal packages.

**For kids**: gentle haircuts for children of all ages.

## Frequently asked questions

**Where is Charmed Family Salon located?**
259, Anandapally Lane, Mahamaya Tala, Garia, Kolkata – 700084. We serve clients from across South Kolkata.

**What are the opening hours?**
Open every day, Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM to 9:00 PM.

**Is Charmed a unisex salon?**
Yes. Charmed is a true unisex family salon with dedicated services for men, women and kids — including haircuts, beard styling, hair colour, keratin, facials, waxing, nails, makeup and bridal packages.

**How do I book an appointment?**
WhatsApp +91 89819 65553 (most slots confirmed within 5 minutes) or call the same number. Walk-ins are welcome subject to availability.

**Do you offer bridal makeup packages?**
Yes — full bridal and groom packages including pre-bridal sessions, HD/airbrush bridal makeup, hair styling, saree draping and party makeup. We recommend booking 4–6 weeks in advance, especially during wedding season (October–February).

**Is there a first-visit discount?**
Yes — first-time clients get 10% off any service. Mention the offer when you walk in or book on WhatsApp.

**How long does keratin last in Kolkata's humidity?**
With proper care and sulphate-free shampoo, keratin lasts 3–5 months even in humid conditions.

**Are the products safe?**
Yes — we use professional, ammonia-free hair colour and clinically-tested skincare brands like VLCC and O3+, never cheap untested products.
